Repo for the syllabi for the courses I teach at RU

```{r, echo=F, message=F, warning=F, results="asis"}
library("glue")
library("fs")

the_syllabi <- dir_ls(regexp = "^[0-9]")
glue("- [{the_syllabi}](https://www.jvcasillas.com/syllabi/{the_syllabi}/index.pdf)")

```
